title: Atlas des Régions Naturelles Poche, Vol. 1
edition: Pocket edition, June 2023. Reprints the whole of the large-format Volume 1.

description.main: Pocket edition of Volume 1 of Eric Tabuchi and Nelly Monnier's Atlas des Régions Naturelles, reprinting the full large-format volume at 12 x 22 cm. Sixteen chapters, more than 650 images, 384 pages.
description.extended:
The pocket edition of Volume 1 of Atlas des Régions Naturelles, known as ARN, reprints the first book of Eric Tabuchi and Nelly Monnier's survey of France's roughly 450 historical "natural regions" as a 12 by 22 centimetre paperback. It carries the whole of the large-format volume at a smaller size.

Poursuite Éditions published it in June 2023. The sixteen chapters run as they do in the original, in sets of three regional portraits followed by one thematic chapter. The regions are Beauce, Cévennes méridionales, Faucigny, Forez, Garrigues, Nivernais, Pays d'Ouche, Porcien, Santerre, Trégor, Val de Loire tourangeau and Hautes Vosges lorraines. The four thematic chapters are Amers, Camouflage, Initiatives personnelles and Piscines verticales. They collect seamarks, camouflage, the private constructions of individuals, and above-ground swimming pools. The publisher counts more than 650 images across 384 pages. The softcover repeats the series design, the letters ARN set vertically with the volume number in the lower corner, here as dark green letters on a lighter green ground. The pocket series started here, two years after the large-format Volume 1 first appeared.

Tabuchi and Monnier began the atlas in 2017. They photograph every region the same way, frontal and level, in flat light, so that buildings from one end of the country to the other read as entries in one inventory. The library holds the eight large-format volumes as separate records and the four pocket volumes alongside them.

notes: Pocket (Poche) edition of Volume 1; the large-format volume is catalogue id 2305. Pocket Vols. 1 through 4 and large-format Vols. 1 through 8 are all held, each as its own record under its own ISBN. The publisher lists the title as "ARN Pocket Vol.1" in English and "Atlas des Régions Naturelles Poche Vol.1" in the page text.
